headline: 復活の混テキスト climbs from 9th to 7th on ARC-AGI-3

sections.text: 復活の混テキスト gained 1.71 to reach 46.82, moving from 9th to 7th on the ARC-AGI-3 public board.

The team had already reached sixth in an earlier story this month, so this is a fresh move up the board rather than a repeat. Public standings remain provisional, and medals are decided on the private board.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
